question_vi: Tổng số đơn hàng là bao nhiêu?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn đã được giao?
question_en: How many orders have been delivered?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

question_vi: Những năm nào có đơn hàng?
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year

question_vi: Top 5 danh mục có nhiều sản phẩm được bán nhất?
question_en: What are the top 5 product categories by number of items sold?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question_vi: Giá trị thanh toán của các đơn đã giao theo năm?
question_en: What is the total payment value of delivered orders by purchase year?
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment FROM orders o JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng đã mua lại?
question_en: How many customers made more than one purchase?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1) AS repeat_customer_ids

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng duy nhất đã mua hàng?
question_en: How many unique customers have purchased?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

question_vi: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng được giao trễ?
question_en: How many orders were delivered late?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS late_deliveries FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
